records.name: Palladium Shopping Mall WC
records.description: Palladium in central Prague has two toilet areas mentioned by the cruising directory, but they're not equally described: the basement WC on level −2 is the one the original contributor considered more active, while the other is on level +2 by the food court. Both still exist, and the shopping centre's operator confirms that since April 2025 they have been managed by M2C. Admission is 20 CZK for adults, payable in Czech crowns by cash or card. The operator gives −2 opening hours of 07:00–21:00 and +2 of 08:00–22:00. Those are toilet hours, not guaranteed cruising periods, and the late-2025 forum messages are requests to meet rather than reports of encounters. If you're already shopping at Palladium, the two levels explain what the original listing meant; it is still a regular public retail WC, not a sex venue.

records.name: Weikerlsee
records.description: Weikerlsee in Linz-Pichling is a pair of connected lakes, and the distinction matters. The smaller lake, Kleiner Weikerlsee, is the swimming area: regular bathing is on its southern shore, while the northern side is the official FKK/naturist section. The larger lake is for walking and nature, with swimming prohibited. That naturist shore explains the older cruising directory reference, but it doesn't establish a particular current meeting corner or a reliably active gay crowd. An April 2026 digital check-in is too little to prove men were meeting. The area is a warm-weather recreation destination with footpaths and plenty of other visitors; don't confuse the larger lake or the whole nature reserve with the smaller lake's designated nude-bathing stretch.

records.name: Terazije public toilet
records.description: This is the public toilet in the underground pedestrian passage beside Palata Albanija, where Terazije meets Sremska and Knez Mihailova in central Belgrade. The location is more precise than a generic 'Terazije toilet': go by the named underground passage rather than looking for facilities on the surface. The city lists the Palata Albanija WC as a free public convenience, normally 07:00–22:30 in winter and 07:00–23:00 in summer. Unlike many other entries, the cruising source has a few actual first-person claims in 2026, including a January visitor saying he met men and a May commenter describing repeated visits. Those are uncorroborated personal reports, not a reason to assume the place is always busy. It is a shared city WC with normal cleaning and visitor rules.

records.name: Bagni Palazzo Reale
records.description: Palazzo Reale is Milan's exhibition palace beside the Duomo, and the old cruising listing is about its visitor toilets rather than the surrounding piazza. There are two, but the museum makes an important access distinction: the ground-floor WC is near the Scalone d'Onore staircase, whereas the first-floor toilet is by exhibition room 143 and serves people attending the current exhibitions. So these are not two general-purpose public toilets available at any time. The directory has a July 2026 online check-in, but that isn't an account of a meeting or even proof someone visited. With gallery opening hours, ticketing and staff supervision, this is a very tentative cruising lead. The verified building layout is useful, but it would be misleading to suggest guaranteed cruising or free access upstairs.

records.name: Neeltje Jans
records.description: Neeltje Jans is a spacious coastal naturist beach on the seaward side of the Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier. A July 2026 visitor says the nude-bathing section now begins at the southern beach access, with clearer signage, and describes parking in the shade beneath the Roompotsluis viaduct. The same visitor warned that kitesurfers were operating unusually close to swimmers, so pay attention to the water as well as the weather. Older guestbook discussions mention men walking in the high dunes, but those are not fresh evidence of current cruising; the dunes themselves are protected and entering them is restricted. If you're going for a naturist beach day, the place and access are well documented. If you're going specifically for cruising, the present reports don't establish reliable activity or a permitted area.

records.name: Spektepark
records.description: Spektepark in Berlin-Spandau stretches around Großer Spektesee, with lawns, walking paths and a car park off Am Kiesteich. The older cruising guide specifically described scrub beside a path from the parking area down towards the lake, rather than the entire park. But the most recent July 2026 forum comment simply asks whether anything still happens, and earlier posts are mixed—so there is no credible present-day cruising timetable. There have also been access changes: the Spektelakesteg I pedestrian bridge was closed after damage in June 2026, although other nearby bridges had reopened. One important correction to older notices: Spandau's 31 August water-quality warning was lifted on 14 September after improved test results. The park is open recreation space; neither that former warning nor the bridge works establishes closure of the whole park.

records.name: Uni-See
records.description: Bremen's Uni-See, officially Stadtwaldsee, has long been popular for swimming and FKK sunbathing. The original cruising guide was more specific than the previous description: it mentioned reeds and wooded ground between Hochschulring and Uni-Wildnis, reached from the western side. Those historic paths may not look the same today. A March 2026 visitor reported that high bushes around the parking area had been cleared, reducing privacy, while a June forum post asked why woodland by the naturist area had been fenced. There is also a separate, serious access issue: northern-shore stabilisation work was scheduled to start in November 2026, with temporary fences and dangerous loose sand until it settles. The FKK beach itself is on the eastern shore; it is not automatically the reported cruising section. Men may still visit, but there is no trustworthy fixed peak or guaranteed clear path.

records.name: P & R Eichlinghofen
records.description: This is the park-and-ride area by Universitätsstraße in Dortmund-Eichlinghofen, with old cruising descriptions referring to the rear of the lot and adjoining shrubs rather than university buildings. The original guide says evenings and weekends were traditionally busiest, but that reflects older listings. A real July 2026 forum comment says there was still activity and describes a mixed, generally older male crowd. Older firsthand reports mention men meeting in the morning and among the bushes, but those are several years old, so they shouldn't be turned into a current schedule. The exact rear parking row hasn't been independently pinned, and parking and shrub access may have changed. It's a more credible lead than a mere digital check-in, but still not somewhere with guaranteed activity.

records.name: Parkplatz an der B 471
records.description: The original source is quite specific: the wooded B471 car park is beside the Isar bridge between Garching and Ismaning. Travelling towards Ismaning, it says to look for the parking area just after the bridge; from Ismaning, the turn-off is before the crossing. A second directory describes a nearby wooded car park and the Isar gravel bank as a traditional spot for gay and bisexual men, though it isn't proven that both directories mean exactly the same parking entrance. Two June 2026 reports paint different pictures: one visitor described men going into the woods on dry afternoons, while another found nobody on two visits. That makes a good-weather afternoon a reported possibility, not a guarantee. Use the source's road and bridge as the location, not a generic Munich pin; check lawful parking and riverside access.
